gaps.detail: Smouha (city and area in TestUserDataSeeder) matches no record in either inspected dataset; preserved manually at import preview, never auto-deleted or re-parented.

Absent from both inspected datasets; no record to import. Other new cities (Shorouk, Badr, Obour, New Cairo 1-3, New Minya/Qena/Sohag/Aswan/Assiut/Fayoum/Akhmim, Burg Al-Arab, Toshka) are present. Requires an authoritative addition before picker coverage can claim the NAC.
All area rows are census shiyakha units flagged provisional-census, not consumer-verified service zones.
Transliterations of uneven quality (e.g. Menia, Muharam Bik); not official translations. Disambiguated rural labels are candidate-only and change nothing in production.
Source zip_codes empty on all records; postal locality mapping is out of scope.
